statement: The Python and JavaScript implementations MUST produce the same outcome — the refusal code, or the display result, signers, signed text and grade — for every input in the counter-vector suite.

decisions.because: Second implementation added for a browser verifier on warrant's WASM core. Writing it found four divergences in the Python implementation before any JS existed (WPDF-D3, WPDF-E4, WPDF-T2), and adding the parity hook found that the hook masked the display default (WPDF-A1).
